name: claim-check
description: Flags PF / profit factor / Sharpe / win rate / WR / t-stat numbers in Claude's final reply that no tool result or user prompt this session backs at the stated precision (corpus 1.3127 backs "1.31"). Also flags a reply that claims done / tests pass when no test or check ran this turn, the last check failed, or files changed after the last green check (toast plus a transcript line; never blocks). One metric toast per turn; /claims lists the last reply's metrics, backed or not, with the nearest corpus number.
